prompt: today, more and more people use robots to do tasks at home and at work. Do you think it is a positive or negative development? Why?
essay:
As society evolves, there has been an ongoing debate regarding whether robots would be highly beneficial for people to use them to do  homework or in the workplace. A group of individuals believe that cutting-edge technology may have a crucial part in personal lives, namely online work or communication, besides helping everyone with daily activities. Others claim that technological advances may place  pressure on sedentary lifestyles and healthcare problems. Therefore, ahead of my opinion, I believe that they can bring a variety of benefits for humans.

On the positive side, a major advantage of high-tech devices is that they can serve as a means of automated systems. They can replace humans by performing repetitive tasks continuously without feeling monotonous or losing concentration, which can increase  productivity. For instance, many factories nowadays are using robots to do dangerous activities and avoid serious incidents in manufacturing processes. A pivotal aspect to consider is that robotic vacuum cleaners or other smart devices are capable of saving people a considerable amount of time or physical health. Consequently, they can support us by cleaning the house or washing the dishes, which helps society have more time to spend with their family members or friends.

On the contrary, high-tech may also have some detrimental consequences in real life. Advanced technology in the future can play an important role in losing jobs or health issues. This occurs because a vast majority of companies are now requiring robotic devices in workplaces to produce products quickly and accurately, leading to the replacement of some low-skilled workers and job displacement. Another compelling factor is that excessive  use of robots can make people become over-reliant on them, create  bad habits and become lazy in daily life. To illustrate, residents are more focused on digital devices, creating their sedentary lifestyle, potentially leading to affect to healthcare problems, such as obesity or sore eyes

In conclusion, although technological development may influence  people’s lives, generate significantly pressing in emotional well-being or physical fitness. These technologies may also bring many more merits on works or daily life. I firmly believe that the development of robots would be better for everybody in workplaces.
